policy: Maintain independently checked official fee evidence by USFS recareaid. Contradictory conclusive statements produce unknown with a conflict flag; retrieval date does not establish source precedence. Revisit these records when agency wording changes. Positive enrichment of an unknown fee requires a named, coordinate-matched official-page observation with an explicit review deadline. The 2026-10-30 reviewed batch uses a 30-day recheck window; subsequent source refreshes drop expired observations and retain unknown fees until rechecked. This is an operational review deadline, not a guarantee that fees cannot change sooner.
